system.description:
FOLKWARDEN

Every knot means something. By the time you finish, there are rather a lot of knots.
Whenever you create a Warding Charm, you may select all protection categories available to you instead of the two granted by Many-Layered Charm.
The charm still provides its bonus against only the triggering saving throw and is expended according to its normal number of activations.
If you possess Body Charm, Body is included amongst the available categories.

Prerequisites Level 14, Charmwright Tradition

Works automatically: Warding Charm's Use takes every protection at once.
